_glossary_comment: Financial/domain terms (Wallet A/B/C, Binary Commission, Direct Commission, BV, Rank, package names, Platform Reserve) are NEVER translated — they stay in English in both locales. Only general UI text, labels, and navigation are translated here.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved.

Login.pageDescription: Welcome back. Enter your details to access your dashboard.
Login.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
Login.totpDescription: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
Login.totpErrorInvalidCode: Invalid authentication code. Please log in again.
Login.enrollDescription: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator, Authy), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
Login.registeredSuccessMessage: Account created successfully. You can now log in.

Register.invalidRefDescription: You need a valid referral link to register.
Register.securityQuestionsDescription: Used to recover your account if you forget your password.
Register.errorPasswordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
Register.errorSecurityQuestionsRequired: All 3 security questions and answers are required.
Register.errorInvalidRef: This referral link is no longer valid.
Register.errorEmailInUse: An account with this email already exists.
Register.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

Dashboard.chartDescription: Daily Wallet A interest over the last 30 days. Fridays are a scheduled pause, not missing data.
Dashboard.chartEmptyState: No profit has accrued yet. It starts once your investment's 7-day waiting period ends.
Dashboard.investmentsDescription: Lock countdowns for your active investments.
Dashboard.investmentsEmptyState: You have no active investments yet. Browse packages to get started.
Dashboard.binaryDescription: Your LEFT/RIGHT volume, qualification status, and time left in this week's cycle.
Dashboard.binaryCycleCloseSrDescription: The current binary cycle closes in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
Dashboard.binaryCycleCloseSrDescriptionToday: The current binary cycle closes today.
Dashboard.rankDescription: Your current rank and progress toward the next one.
Dashboard.rankMaxAchievedDescription: There's no higher rank to progress toward — you've achieved the top rank.

Ranking.pageDescription: Your current rank, progress toward the next one, and the full rank ladder.
Ranking.progressDescription: Current rank and progress toward the next one.
Ranking.ladderDescription: Every active rank and what it takes to reach it.

Packages.pageDescription: Choose a package to turn your Wallet B credit into an active investment.
Packages.emptyState: No packages are available for purchase right now.
Packages.confirmDescription: This will debit {amount} from your Wallet B and credit it to Wallet A.
Packages.errorInsufficientFunds: Your Wallet B balance is not enough to purchase this package.
Packages.errorPackageUnavailable: This package is no longer available for purchase.
Packages.errorGeneric: Something went wrong while processing your purchase. Please try again.

Investments.pageDescription: Track your active investments and their upcoming unlock dates.
Investments.profitStartsInDays: Starts in {days, plural, =1 {1 day} other {# days}}
Investments.capitalUnlocksInDays: Unlocks in {days, plural, =1 {1 day} other {# days}}
Investments.emptyStateDescription: Browse available packages to make your first investment.

Withdrawals.pageDescription: Move profit and commission to Wallet B, release unlocked capital, or request a Wallet B exit.
Withdrawals.transfersDescription: Self-service, instant. Wallet A profit is available on Fridays only; Wallet C commission is available any day.
Withdrawals.transferConfirmDescriptionA: This will move {amount} of profit from Wallet A to Wallet B.
Withdrawals.transferConfirmDescriptionC: This will move {amount} of commission from Wallet C to Wallet B.
Withdrawals.transferSuccessDescription: Your Wallet B balance has been updated.
Withdrawals.fridayOnlyCountdown: Available on Fridays only. {days, plural, =0 {Available today} =1 {1 day remaining} other {# days remaining}}
Withdrawals.capitalReleaseDescription: Release principal from a fully unlocked investment into Wallet B. Available on Fridays only.
Withdrawals.capitalReleaseEmptyState: No active investments with capital to release.
Withdrawals.capitalReleaseConfirmDescription: This will move {amount} of principal from Wallet A to Wallet B. This investment will stop earning interest.
Withdrawals.capitalReleaseSuccessDescription: Your Wallet B balance has been updated.
Withdrawals.savingLotsDescription: The locked portion of your Direct Commission, and when each part unlocks into Wallet C.
Withdrawals.savingLotsEmptyState: You have no SAVING lots yet.
Withdrawals.bExitDescription: Submit a request to withdraw funds out of the simulation. Requires admin approval.
Withdrawals.bExitConfirmDescription: This will submit a request to withdraw {amount} from Wallet B, pending admin approval.
Withdrawals.bExitSuccessDescription: Your request is now pending admin review.
Withdrawals.bExitEmptyState: You have no Wallet B exit requests yet.
Withdrawals.errorAmountInvalid: Enter a valid amount greater than zero.
Withdrawals.errorInsufficientBalance: This amount exceeds what's available to transfer.
Withdrawals.errorNotFriday: This action is only available on Fridays.
Withdrawals.errorSuspended: Your account is suspended; withdrawals and transfers are blocked.
Withdrawals.errorCapitalLocked: This investment's capital is still within its 6-month lock.
Withdrawals.errorAlreadyReleased: This investment's capital has already been released.
Withdrawals.errorNotOwned: This investment could not be found.
Withdrawals.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

Transfer.pageDescription: Send Wallet B funds directly to another user. Instant, self-service, available any day.
Transfer.sectionDescription: Search by name or email, enter an amount, and confirm.
Transfer.confirmDescription: This will send {amount} from your Wallet B to {recipientName}'s Wallet B.
Transfer.successDescription: {recipientName} has received the funds in their Wallet B.
Transfer.errorAmountInvalid: Enter a valid amount greater than zero.
Transfer.errorInsufficientBalance: This amount exceeds your Wallet B balance.
Transfer.errorSuspended: Your account is suspended; withdrawals and transfers are blocked.
Transfer.errorRecipientNotFound: This recipient is unavailable for transfers.
Transfer.errorSelfTransfer: You cannot transfer to your own account.
Transfer.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

Transactions.pageDescription: Every credit and debit across your wallets, with filters by wallet, type, and date.
Transactions.listDescription: Filter by wallet, type, or date range.
Transactions.emptyStateDescription: Try widening your filters, or check back once you have some activity.
Transactions.errorForbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
Transactions.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

Referrals.pageDescription: Share your referral code and track your direct referrals and Direct Commission history.
Referrals.referralCodeDescription: Share this link or code, or let someone scan the QR code, to register under you as their sponsor.
Referrals.qrCodeAlt: QR code for your referral link
Referrals.referralsEmptyStateDescription: Share your referral code above to start growing your network.
Referrals.commissionHistoryDescription: Payouts earned when your direct referrals make their first purchase.
Referrals.commissionHistoryEmptyState: You have not earned any Direct Commission yet.

BinaryTree.pageDescription: Your placement in the binary tree and the downline below you.
BinaryTree.treeDescription: Shown down to 5 levels below you. LEFT and RIGHT reflect actual placement, not your display language.
BinaryTree.emptyStateTitle: You have not been placed yet
BinaryTree.emptyStateDescription: Your position in the binary tree is assigned automatically once someone sponsors you.
BinaryTree.noDownlineYetNote: You have no downline yet. New referrals placed under you will appear here.
BinaryTree.cycleDescription: Your BV, qualification status, and Binary Commission for the current weekly cycle.
BinaryTree.noCycleHistoryDescription: Your first weekly binary cycle has not closed yet. Volume and qualification status will appear here after the next Saturday close.
BinaryTree.reasonAccountSuspended: Your account is currently suspended, so this cycle was not eligible for payout.
BinaryTree.reasonNoActiveInvestment: You need an active investment to qualify for Binary Commission.
BinaryTree.reasonLeftLegInactive: Your LEFT leg has no active member holding capital, so this cycle was not eligible for payout.
BinaryTree.reasonRightLegInactive: Your RIGHT leg has no active member holding capital, so this cycle was not eligible for payout.
BinaryTree.cycleClosesInDays: Cycle closes in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
BinaryTree.estimatedCommissionNote: What you would earn if the cycle closed right now, based on current volumes. Not a guarantee — qualification is checked at the actual Saturday close.

Profile.changePasswordDescription: Choose a new password with at least 8 characters.
Profile.errorPasswordTooShort: The new password must be at least 8 characters.
Profile.errorPasswordMismatch: The new password and confirmation do not match.
Profile.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

AdminSettings.pageDescription: Manage your main admin account: email, password, and two-factor authentication.
AdminSettings.emailDescription: Your current password is required to confirm this change.
AdminSettings.changePasswordDescription: Choose a new password with at least 8 characters.
AdminSettings.totpDescription: Re-enrolling replaces your current authenticator device — the old one stops working immediately once you confirm the new code.
AdminSettings.totpScanInstruction: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator, Authy), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
AdminSettings.errorEmailInUse: This email address is already in use.
AdminSettings.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

AdminSubAdmins.pageDescription: Create sub-admin accounts, assign permissions, and review their action history. Only the main admin can manage this.
AdminSubAdmins.createDescription: Sub-admins cannot create further sub-admins, no matter which permissions they hold.
AdminSubAdmins.reasonPlaceholder: Why is this account being created?
AdminSubAdmins.confirmDeactivateDescription: They will no longer be able to log in or take any admin action.
AdminSubAdmins.confirmReactivateDescription: They will be able to log in again with their existing credentials.
AdminSubAdmins.errorEmailInUse: An account with this email already exists.
AdminSubAdmins.errorNotMainAdmin: Only the main admin can perform this action.
AdminSubAdmins.errorTargetNotSubAdmin: This account is not a sub-admin.
AdminSubAdmins.errorCannotModifyMainAdmin: The main admin account cannot be modified here.
AdminSubAdmins.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

AdminOverview.pageDescription: A glance view of investments, platform financial health, user activity, and background job status.
AdminOverview.upcomingReleasesDescription: Active investments whose 6-month lock ends within the next 30 days.
AdminOverview.upcomingReleasesEmpty: No capital releases due in the next 30 days.
AdminOverview.jobHealthCardDescription: Last run status of every scheduled job.

AdminUsers.pageDescription: Create user accounts, search existing users, and manage suspensions. Admin creation is the only way new users enter the system.
AdminUsers.createDescription: Sets an initial password and, optionally, a sponsor. The new user can change their password after logging in.
AdminUsers.reasonPlaceholder: Why is this account being created?
AdminUsers.confirmSuspendDescription: This is a full financial freeze — all transfers, withdrawals, and interest accrual for this account stop immediately.
AdminUsers.confirmReinstateDescription: This lifts the financial freeze and restores normal account activity.
AdminUsers.resetPasswordReasonPlaceholder: Why is this password being reset?
AdminUsers.resetPasswordConfirmDescription: This will immediately replace {name}'s password. They will need to use the new password to log in.
AdminUsers.errorSponsorNotFound: The selected sponsor could not be found.
AdminUsers.errorSponsorSuspended: The selected sponsor's account is suspended.
AdminUsers.errorEmailInUse: An account with this email already exists.
AdminUsers.errorCannotSuspendMainAdmin: The main admin account cannot be suspended.
AdminUsers.errorCannotResetMainAdminPassword: The main admin's password cannot be reset this way — use the admin settings page instead.
AdminUsers.errorPasswordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
AdminUsers.errorForbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action.
AdminUsers.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

AdminWithdrawals.pageDescription: Review and decide pending Wallet B exit requests. The $50 minimum and Friday-only submission rules were already enforced when the user submitted — this screen only handles the approve/reject decision.
AdminWithdrawals.reasonPlaceholder: Why is this request being approved or rejected?
AdminWithdrawals.confirmApproveDescription: This immediately debits the user's Wallet B and burns the amount out of the simulation. This cannot be undone.
AdminWithdrawals.confirmRejectDescription: The request is closed with no funds moved. The user keeps their Wallet B balance.
AdminWithdrawals.errorAlreadyDecided: This request has already been decided.
AdminWithdrawals.errorForbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action.
AdminWithdrawals.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

AdminCredits.pageDescription: Credit Wallet B directly on behalf of a user. This is the only way funds enter the simulation, so every issuance requires a reason and is logged.
AdminCredits.formDescription: Search for the user, enter an amount, and give a reason before confirming.
AdminCredits.reasonPlaceholder: Why is this credit being issued?
AdminCredits.confirmCreditDescription: Review the details below before issuing. This creates new funds in the simulation and cannot be undone.
AdminCredits.errorAmountInvalid: Enter a valid amount greater than zero.
AdminCredits.errorUserNotFound: The selected user could not be found.
AdminCredits.errorUserSuspended: The selected user's account is suspended.
AdminCredits.errorForbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action.
AdminCredits.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

AdminPackages.pageDescription: Create, edit, and deactivate the fixed-tier investment packages users can purchase.
AdminPackages.createDescription: Packages are fixed-amount tiers, not a range — set the exact amount.
AdminPackages.editDescription: Only the name and amount can be changed here.
AdminPackages.editLockedNotice: {count, plural, one {# investment has} other {# investments have}} already been made under this package — name and amount are locked. Deactivate it instead to stop new purchases.
AdminPackages.errorAmountInvalid: Enter a valid amount greater than zero.
AdminPackages.errorHasInvestments: This package has existing investments and cannot be edited. Deactivate it instead.
AdminPackages.errorNotFound: This package could not be found.
AdminPackages.errorForbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action.
AdminPackages.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

AdminRateConfig.pageDescription: The global daily interest rate, applied uniformly to every active investment. Changes are forward-effective only — never grandfathered or backdated.
AdminRateConfig.setDescription: The new rate takes effect on the date you choose and applies to every calculation from that date forward — past calculations are never recalculated.
AdminRateConfig.errorRateInvalid: Enter a valid rate greater than zero.
AdminRateConfig.errorBackdated: The effective date must be in the future — rate changes cannot be backdated.
AdminRateConfig.errorForbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action.
AdminRateConfig.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

AdminCommissionConfig.pageDescription: Direct Commission rate and split, Binary Commission rate, and the carry-forward expiry window. Changes are forward-effective only — never grandfathered or backdated.
AdminCommissionConfig.setDescription: The new rules take effect on the date you choose and apply to every calculation from that date forward — past calculations are never recalculated.
AdminCommissionConfig.reasonPlaceholder: Why are the commission rules changing?
AdminCommissionConfig.splitSumHint: Commission split + Saving split must sum to 100% (currently {sum}%).
AdminCommissionConfig.errorRateInvalid: Enter a valid rate greater than zero.
AdminCommissionConfig.errorSplitMismatch: Commission split and Saving split must sum to exactly 100%.
AdminCommissionConfig.errorMonthsInvalid: Enter a valid whole number of months, greater than zero.
AdminCommissionConfig.errorBackdated: The effective date must be in the future — commission rule changes cannot be backdated.
AdminCommissionConfig.errorForbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action.
AdminCommissionConfig.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

AdminRankConfig.pageDescription: Per-rank MRV threshold, referral count, and reward — plus adding new ranks above the top of the hierarchy. Changes never affect a rank a user has already achieved.
AdminRankConfig.listDescription: In order from lowest to highest.
AdminRankConfig.editDescription: MRV threshold, referral count, and reward amount only — the rank's position and name cannot be changed here.
AdminRankConfig.editLockedNotice: This rank has already been achieved by at least one user and can no longer be edited.
AdminRankConfig.addAboveTopNotice: A new rank is always added above the current top of the hierarchy — its position cannot be chosen manually.
AdminRankConfig.addDescription: Creates a brand-new rank, effective immediately.
AdminRankConfig.errorMrvInvalid: Enter a valid MRV threshold greater than zero.
AdminRankConfig.errorReferralsInvalid: Enter a valid whole number of referrals, greater than zero.
AdminRankConfig.errorRewardInvalid: Enter a valid reward amount greater than zero.
AdminRankConfig.errorAlreadyAchieved: This rank has already been achieved by at least one user and cannot be edited.
AdminRankConfig.errorOrderTooLow: A new rank must be added above the current top of the hierarchy.
AdminRankConfig.errorForbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action.
AdminRankConfig.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

AdminManualAdjustment.pageDescription: Correct a ledger error by posting a new reversing entry. This never edits or deletes history — every correction is a brand-new, equal-and-opposite entry.
AdminManualAdjustment.reverseDescription: Search for the user, select the entry to reverse, then confirm.
AdminManualAdjustment.entriesEmpty: This user has no ledger entries.
AdminManualAdjustment.willPostLabel: This will post the following new entries:
AdminManualAdjustment.confirmReversalDescription: Review exactly what will be posted before confirming. This creates new entries and cannot be undone by editing — only by a further reversal.
AdminManualAdjustment.reasonPlaceholder: Why is this transaction being reversed?
AdminManualAdjustment.reversalSuccessDescription: The correcting entries have been posted.
AdminManualAdjustment.errorNotFound: No ledger entries found for this transaction.
AdminManualAdjustment.errorAlreadyReversed: This transaction has already been reversed.
AdminManualAdjustment.errorForbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action.
AdminManualAdjustment.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

AdminLedger.pageDescription: Search, filter, and export the full ledger history across every user and wallet.
AdminLedger.listDescription: Combine filters by user, entry type, wallet, and date range.
AdminLedger.errorForbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action.
AdminLedger.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

AdminSecurityEvents.pageDescription: Failed logins, lockouts, 2FA changes, and admin actions in one chronological feed.
AdminSecurityEvents.listDescription: Combine filters by user, event source, and date range.
AdminSecurityEvents.errorForbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action.
AdminSecurityEvents.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

AdminJobMonitor.pageDescription: The health of every scheduled background job, and a safe manual re-trigger if one falls behind or fails. This screen only monitors and triggers the existing scheduler — it never replaces or duplicates it.
AdminJobMonitor.errorForbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action.
AdminJobMonitor.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

AdminSolvency.pageDescription: The simulation's financial health at a glance — every number here is a direct aggregation from the ledger and wallet tables, not a new calculation.
AdminSolvency.totalCreditIssuedDescription: All money ever credited into the simulation by an admin — the only source of funds entering it.
AdminSolvency.totalLiabilitiesDescription: What the platform owes users right now — the sum of every real wallet balance.
AdminSolvency.ratioDescription: Credit issued as a percentage of current liabilities.
AdminSolvency.ratioUndefined: Undefined — there are no liabilities to compare against yet.
AdminSolvency.projectionDescription: A rough estimate of Wallet A's total balance 30 days from now, at today's active interest rate.
AdminSolvency.projectionEstimateNotice: This is an estimate only — it does not account for Fridays being paused or new investments' 7-day delay, and is not a substitute for the real daily accrual engine.
AdminSolvency.errorForbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action.
AdminSolvency.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
